<!--Notes-->
|note_res_REL=[[Vitória F.C.|Vitória de Setúbal]] and [[C.D. Aves|Aves]] failed to produce valid licensing documentation to compete in the 2020–21 seasons of the [[2020–21 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]] and [[2020–21 LigaPro|LigaPro]], respectively, so they were punished by the [[Liga Portuguesa de Futebol Profissional|Portuguese Professional Football League]] with direct relegation to the [[2020–21 Campeonato de Portugal|Campeonato de Portugal]]. As a result, [[Portimonense S.C.|Portimonense]] (17th place) were invited to remain in the top tier for the 2020–21 season.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Aves e V. Setúbal falham licenciamento e descem ao Campeonato de Portugal|url=https://www.abola.pt/nnh/2020-07-29/liga-aves-e-v-setubal-falham-licenciamento-e-descem-ao-campeonato-de-portugal/855184|website=A BOLA|language=pt|date=29 July 2020}}</ref>
